changelog:
- Minimalist Privacy Gateway: Clean single bold letter badges (O for Tor, C for Custom, D for Direct), removal of emojis, pills, and wordy descriptions.
- Streamlined Command Bar: Removed Reader, AI Summary sparkle, and VPN key buttons from the bottom command card for a distraction-free browsing bar (all accessible via 3-dots menu).
- Context-Aware Curiosity Searches: Deep-dive questions now prepend the article topic/title so search engines receive full context.
- Sleek Feature Hubs: Cleaned up 3-dots menu feature hub rows by removing sub-explanations and navigation arrows.
